Method of Attack: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption, can exhaust system resources leading to a Denial of Service (DoS) condition.
Impacted Systems: Systems using vulnerable versions of spring-security-oauth2-client
Attack Vector: The attacker repeatedly sends authorization requests to the application, one after another, or even writes a simple script to quickly and easily fire off thousands. The application will attempt to blindly store all of them.
Indicators of Compromise: System resources exhausted, ultimately resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS) condition.
